## Gate Rejected
**Timestamp**: 2026-09-23T23:28:58Z
**Event**: GATE_REJECTED
**Stage**: functional-design
**Feedback**: Close the FR4.3 ownership gap: decide which unit owns filling Home's recent-posts and selected-projects sections, specify the selection count and the behaviour when fewer items exist than the count, and record it in that unit's traceability; remove the duplicate completion claims from the units that do not own it. Define BR7.1 (and BR7.2/BR7.3) in the unit that owns the publishing route, or remove the u4 W3 citation; add the owning actor to the component catalogue. Also: reconcile entities.md's Post.date min/max bound with BR2.3; add step 3 (slug validation) to u1's field-error aggregation at step 11; reconcile NFR6's one-hit-target clause with u3's deliberate two-target Projects rows and name the exception in both u3 and u5; add BR11.5 to u5's traceability coverage and reverse arrays; correct BR9.1's [Q1] source citation; and fix the three citations of the nonexistent team-practices.md to aidlc/spaces/default/memory/team.md.
